meta.title: 质谱裂解规律标准规则库 — Mass Spectrometry Fragmentation Rules Library
meta.description: 基于母核结构的小分子化合物及中药化合物质谱裂解特征规则库，涵盖44+化合物类别、235+条裂解规则、精确质量参考表。整合PubMed/MoNA/GNPS/MassBank/HMDB/LIPID MAPS等来源。
meta.principle: 化合物的质谱裂解行为由其母核结构决定
data_sources: GNPS — Global Natural Product Social Molecular Networking (https://gnps.ucsd.edu/)

classes.core_structure: C6-C3-C6 (二苯基色原酮母核, 2-phenylchromone)

subclasses.core_description: 2-苯基色原酮, C2-C3双键, C4羰基

rules.description: RDA逆Diels-Alder裂解产生1,3A+和1,3B+特征碎片离子，1,3A+通常为基峰
rules.reference: Ma et al., 1997; Tsimogiannis et al., 2007; Abad-Garcia et al., 2009; PMID:17937460

rules.description: 1,3A+碎片进一步丢失C2H2O (42 Da)，为黄酮和黄酮醇的关键诊断特征
rules.mechanism: RDA后连续中性丢失 — C2H2O消除
rules.reference: Kuhn et al., 2003; Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 1,3B+碎片丢失2H (2 Da)，为黄酮区别于黄酮醇的特征
rules.reference: Kuhn et al., 2003; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 1,3A+碎片丢失CO (28 Da)
rules.reference: Fabre et al., 2001; PMID:11199231

rules.description: A环5,7-二羟基取代黄酮的诊断性碎片离子，RDA裂解产生1,3A+离子
rules.mechanism: 逆Diels-Alder — C环1,3键断裂(5,7-diOH A环)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(A环取代基诊断)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 黄烷醇类(如儿茶素)的A环碎片离子，无C4酮基但有5,7-二OH的标志
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: A环含一个OH和一个OCH3取代的黄酮诊断性碎片离子
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(A环甲氧基诊断)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 甲氧基化黄酮在负离子模式以丢失CH3自由基为特征，形成奇电子离子[M-H-CH3]⁻•
rules.mechanism: 自由基脱甲基 (Methyl radical loss)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

subclasses.core_description: 3-羟基黄酮, C3-OH

rules.description: RDA裂解: 1,3A+为基峰, 同时产生1,3A+−CO, 1,3A+−CO2等碎片。0,2B+离子在黄酮醇中也很突出
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, J. Mass Spectrom. 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 黄酮醇的1,3A+碎片丢失CO (28 Da) 非常特征，因C3-OH促进该中性丢失
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 黄酮醇丢失H2O (18 Da), C3-OH容易脱水
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 连续丢失两分子CO (56 Da)，黄酮醇特征性连续丢失
rules.reference: Tsimogiannis et al., 2007; PMID:17343468

rules.fragment_mz: m/z 153 (槲皮素/山奈酚), m/z 169 (杨梅素)
rules.description: 黄酮醇A环取代基诊断: 5,7-二OH→m/z 153; 5,7-二OH+三OH→m/z 169
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 槲皮素(Quercetin, MW 302)正离子全碎片级联: RDA碎片m/z 153(A环5,7-diOH标志), m/z 165(rC3,10A)。负离子m/z 301→273(-CO)→257→229
rules.mechanism: RDA裂解 + 连续脱水/脱羰
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(槲皮素诊断)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 山奈酚(Kaempferol)正离子: m/z 153(rC1,4A)为A环5,7-diOH标志; m/z 177(rC5,10B)为B环4'-OH标志; 级联269→241→213
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(山奈酚诊断)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 甲氧基化黄酮醇诊断: Rhamnetin(A环含OMe+OH)→rC1,4A碎片m/z 167(与m/z 153差14 Da=CH2); Isorhamnetin(B环含OMe)→rC1,4A碎片仍为m/z 153(A环未变)
rules.mechanism: RDA裂解 — A环OMe取代使碎片从m/z 153→167
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(A环OMe取代诊断, 153→167位移)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

subclasses.core_description: C2-C3单键, C4羰基

rules.description: RDA裂解: 1,3A+为基峰, 同时0,4B+也为基峰
rules.reference: Zhang et al., 2011; PMID:21885228

rules.description: 二氢黄酮的1,3B+离子显著，区别于黄酮
rules.reference: Zhang et al., 2011; PMID:21885228

rules.description: 二氢黄酮苷元可通过RDA裂解丢失C8H8O3 (152 Da，对应A环+C2片段)
rules.reference: Yang et al., Eur. J. Mass Spectrom. 2012; PMID:23221113

subclasses.core_description: 3-苯基色原酮, B环连C3

rules.description: 异黄酮的0,2B+离子突出，因B环在C3位改变了RDA裂解路径
rules.reference: Kuhn et al., 2003; Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 异黄酮RDA裂解模式与黄酮不同，B环连接位置导致特征性0,2裂解产物
rules.reference: Kuhn et al., 2003; PMID:15389856

subclasses.core_description: 开环C6-C3-C6, α,β-不饱和羰基(查尔酮); C3饱和(二氢查尔酮)

rules.description: 查尔酮经RDA裂解产生1,3A-碎片（与二氢黄酮共享特征）
rules.reference: Yang et al., Eur. J. Mass Spectrom. 2012; PMID:23221113

rules.description: 甲氧基化查尔酮在负离子模式MS2中以丢失CH3自由基(-15 Da)为主
rules.mechanism: 自由基裂解 — 甲氧基脱甲基
rules.reference: Portet et al., J. Chromatogr. A 2008; PMID:18838145

rules.description: 二氢查尔酮以B3苄基裂解离子为特征（饱和C3桥），区别于查尔酮的B5离子
rules.reference: Mabry & Markham, 1975; J. Agric. Food Chem. 1992, 40:610

rules.description: 甲氧基化二氢查尔酮在负离子MS2中以丢失H2O (-18 Da)为主导
rules.reference: Portet et al., J. Chromatogr. A 2008; PMID:18838145

subclasses.core_description: 2-苯基苯并吡喃鎓盐(flavylium), C环氧被正电荷替代

rules.description: 花青素的0,2B+通常为基峰，为正离子模式下最特征碎片
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 0,2B+碎片进一步丢失C2H2O (42 Da)，花青素的诊断性中性丢失
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

subclasses.core_description: 黄酮母核连接糖基(O-苷或C-苷)

rules.description: O-黄酮苷以丢失完整糖基为特征: 己糖-162 Da, 脱氧己糖-146 Da, 戊糖-132 Da
rules.neutral_loss: C6H10O5 (162 Da, hexose) / C6H10O4 (146 Da, deoxyhexose) / C5H8O4 (132 Da, pentose)
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856; PMID:16418439

rules.description: C-黄酮苷以糖环交叉环裂解为特征，产生-60 Da, -90 Da, -120 Da碎片序列
rules.reference: Abad-Garcia et al., 2009; PMID:25981540

rules.description: C-黄酮苷(尤其是6-C-苷)在负离子模式中产生显著的[M-H-18]-脱水离子
rules.reference: Abad-Garcia et al., 2009; PMID:25981540

rules.mechanism: 糖基交叉环裂解相对强度比
rules.reference: Abad-Garcia et al., 2009; PMID:25981540

rules.description: 黄酮苷糖单元特征碎片: 己糖oxonium离子m/z 161; 脱氧己糖碎片m/z 143; 戊糖碎片m/z 131
rules.mechanism: 糖单元交叉环裂解产生oxonium离子
rules.reference: Alves et al., RSC Adv. 2024; PMC10985591; PMID:16418439

rules.description: O-苷的苷元离子Y0-为主要碎片，用于确定苷元分子量和糖链组成
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: 酰化黄酮苷以丢失酰基为首要裂解(酰基先于糖丢失)。丙二酰黄酮苷: -CO2(44)+-C2H2O(42)=-86 Da, 或整体丢失丙二酸(86 Da)。乙酰黄酮苷: -CH3COOH(60)或-C2H2O(42)。对香豆酰: -C9H6O(146)。阿魏酰: -C10H8O3(176)。裂解顺序: [M+H]+→[M+H-acyl]+→[M+H-acyl-sugar]+→aglycone
rules.mechanism: 酰基酯键断裂(优先于糖苷键) → 糖丢失 → 苷元
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失顺序(酰基→糖, 诊断酰化黄酮苷)
rules.reference: PMID:18074333 malonylation patterns; Ferreres et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2004

rules.description: 黄酮硫酸酯以丢失SO3 (79.96 Da)为最诊断特征(负离子模式)。诊断碎片: m/z 97(HSO4-)和m/z 80(SO3-.)。多硫酸酯有多次-80 Da丢失。SO3丢失后苷元按黄酮规则裂解。不同硫酸酯位置(如3-O-sulfate vs 7-O-sulfate)需MSn区分(RDA碎片丰度不同)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失+特征碎片(硫酸酯诊断)
rules.reference: Frontiers Plant Sci. 2019, 10:885 sulfated flavonoids; KAUST sulfated flavonoid review

subclasses.subclass: 多甲氧基黄酮 (Polymethoxylated Flavonoids / PMFs)
subclasses.core_description: 黄酮母核多个甲氧基取代，不含游离羟基(或极少)

rules.description: 多甲氧基黄酮最特征裂解为连续丢失CH3自由基(-15 Da)。每个甲氧基可产生一次脱甲基，Nobiletin(6-OMe, MW 402)→m/z 387→372→357→342→327→312→297
rules.mechanism: 自由基脱甲基 (Successive CH3 radical loss)
rules.reference: Zhang et al., J. Pharm. Biomed. Anal. 2011;56:950-961; PMID:21885228

rules.description: PMFs同时发生甲氧基整体丢失(-31 Da, OCH3)，与CH3自由基丢失竞争。在低碰撞能下CH3丢失占主导，高碰撞能下OCH3丢失增加
rules.mechanism: 甲氧基整体消除 vs 自由基脱甲基竞争
rules.reference: Zhang et al., 2011; PMID:21885228

rules.description: 含邻位甲氧基的PMFs可发生邻位消除反应丢失CH3OH(-32 Da)，如3'-甲氧基与4'-甲氧基之间的消除
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

subclasses.core_description: C2-C3单键(饱和), C3-OH, C4羰基; 与二氢黄酮区别在于C3-OH

rules.description: 二氢黄酮醇以脱水(-18 Da)和脱甲酸(-46 Da)为首要中性丢失，C3-OH+C4=O促进连续丢失H2O+CO
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: Taxifolin(dihydroquercetin)特征碎片级联: m/z 305→287→259→231，连续脱水脱羰，与二氢黄酮(Naringenin)不同的是C3-OH使脱水更显著
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(二氢黄酮醇诊断)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

rules.description: 二氢黄酮醇A环5,7-二OH取代时RDA碎片m/z 153与黄酮/黄酮醇共享，但二氢黄酮醇的C3-OH使前体离子质量多2Da(比对应黄酮醇)
rules.reference: Jiang et al., Molecules 2024, 29, 5246; PMC11596855

subclasses.subclass: 黄芩属黄酮苷 (Scutellaria-specific Flavone Glycosides)
subclasses.core_description: 黄芩苷元葡萄糖醛酸苷(O-苷)，不含5-OH的独特黄酮

rules.description: 黄芩苷(baicalin)在负离子模式: [M-H]- m/z 445→m/z 269(丢失葡萄糖醛酸176 Da产生黄芩苷元)。汉黄芩苷: m/z 459→m/z 283
rules.mechanism: O-糖苷键断裂 — 葡萄糖醛酸(-176 Da)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(O-葡萄糖醛酸苷)
rules.reference: Acta Chromatographica 2023; Scutellaria flavonoid profiling; PMID:25981540

rules.description: 黄芩苷元(baicalein, MW 270)在负离子MS3: m/z 269→251(H2O)→241(CO)→223(H2O+CO)。5,6,7-三OH取代使脱水极显著(3次H2O丢失)
rules.mechanism: 连续脱水+脱羰基 (C环裂解)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(黄芩苷元诊断)
rules.reference: Acta Chromatographica 2023; Dehkordi et al., 2020

rules.description: 野黄芩苷(scutellarin, scutellarein-7-C-glucuronide): 兼具C-苷特征(糖环交叉环裂解-120/-90 Da碎片)和苷元碎片m/z 285
rules.mechanism: C-糖苷键裂解 + 交叉环裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(C-葡萄糖醛酸苷)
rules.reference: Kachlicki et al., Molecules 2016, 21:1494; PMC5067219

rules.description: 酰化黄酮苷以丢失酰基为首要裂解(酰基先于糖丢失)。丙二酰黄酮苷: -CO2(44)+-C2H2O(42)=-86 Da, 或整体丢失丙二酸(86 Da)。乙酰黄酮苷: -CH3COOH(60)或-C2H2O(42)。对香豆酰: -C9H6O(146)。阿魏酰: -C10H8O3(176)。裂解顺序: [M+H]+→[M+H-acyl]+→[M+H-acyl-sugar]+→aglycone
rules.mechanism: 酰基酯键断裂(优先于糖苷键) → 糖丢失 → 苷元
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失顺序(酰基→糖, 诊断酰化黄酮苷)
rules.reference: PMID:18074333 malonylation patterns; Ferreres et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2004

rules.description: 黄酮硫酸酯以丢失SO3 (79.96 Da)为最诊断特征(负离子模式)。诊断碎片: m/z 97(HSO4-)和m/z 80(SO3-.)。多硫酸酯有多次-80 Da丢失。SO3丢失后苷元按黄酮规则裂解。不同硫酸酯位置(如3-O-sulfate vs 7-O-sulfate)需MSn区分(RDA碎片丰度不同)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失+特征碎片(硫酸酯诊断)
rules.reference: Frontiers Plant Sci. 2019, 10:885 sulfated flavonoids; KAUST sulfated flavonoid review

subclasses.core_description: 两个黄酮单元通过C3'-C8'(或C8-C8')键连接

rules.description: 双黄酮以C3'-C8'分子间键断裂和RDA裂解为特征。甲基化双黄酮: 由连续CH3丢失(15 Da)次数确定甲氧基数。amentoflavone(0×OCH3, 539)→无CH3丢失; bilobetin(1×OCH3, 553)→1次; ginkgetin(2×OCH3, 567)→2次; sciadopitysin(3×OCH3, 581)→3次。MS3可确定甲氧基位于哪个黄酮单元
rules.mechanism: 分子间C-C键断裂 + RDA + 连续脱甲基
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(CH3丢失次数=甲氧基数)
rules.reference: PMC9824678 Ginkgo biflavonoids; MDPI Molecules 2021, 26:6088 biflavonoid review

classes.core_structure: 含氮杂环母核 (N-heterocyclic core)

general_rules.description: 氮规则: 含奇数N原子→分子离子[M+H]+为偶数m/z; 含偶数N原子→分子离子为奇数m/z。适用于所有含氮化合物
general_rules.reference: McLafferty & Turecek, Interpretation of Mass Spectra, 4th Ed.

general_rules.description: 质子化优先发生在碱性氮原子上（杂环N > 羰基O），碱性强弱决定碎片化路径
α-裂解（氮原子α位C-C键断裂）是生物碱最普遍的特征裂解方式

subclasses.core_description: 异喹啉母核 (C9H7N)

rules.description: 苄基四氢异喹啉和阿朴啡类生物碱产生m/z<200的特征碎片离子
rules.reference: PMID:25533540 (systematic identification of isoquinoline alkaloids)

rules.description: 四氢原小檗碱和N-甲基四氢原小檗碱: RDA裂解 + α-裂解 + [M-H2O]+ 和 [M-CH4]+
原小檗碱、苯并菲啶类: [碎片离子-2H]+, [M-H2O]+, [M-CH4]+, [M+H-C3H7OH]+, [M+H-CH3COCH3]+
原小檗碱类以C环RDA裂解为特征，AB环和D环碎片可区分不同取代模式
19种异喹啉生物碱亚型(66种化合物)通过Q-TOF-MS/MS+计算化学验证: 碎片离子归因于中性NHR1R2的丢失，各亚型具有独特的MS/MS碎片模式
rules.mechanism: 氮杂环裂解 + 计算化学验证
rules.reference: Nature Sci. Rep. 2020; PMID:31959815

subclasses.core_description: 吲哚母核 (C8H7N)

rules.description: 士的宁类: MS2活性裂解位点位于氮桥和配位氧原子; MS3以丢失CH3或OCH3自由基为主
rules.mechanism: 氮桥裂解 + 自由基脱甲基/脱甲氧基

rules.description: 简单吲哚生物碱通过β-裂解产生特征性喹啉离子m/z 144
rules.reference: McLafferty & Turecek, 4th Ed.

rules.description: 单萜吲哚生物碱(MIA)利用MSⁿ和ToF-MS联用可快速鉴定，特征碎片反映柯南烷/白坚木碱等骨架类型
rules.reference: PMID:21828417 (Nauclea officinalis MIA identification)

rules.description: Plumeran型吲哚生物碱在负离子ESI-MS/MS中可建立15种裂解路径，用于骨架结构推断
rules.mechanism: 负离子模式多路径裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 诊断性产物离子(负离子)
rules.reference: ChemRxiv 2025; Plumeran indole alkaloid fragmentation

subclasses.core_description: C19或C20二萜骨架含氮

rules.description: 乌头碱类: 特征性连续丢失AcOH (60 Da), BzOH (122 Da), CH3OH (32 Da), H2O (18 Da)
rules.neutral_loss: C2H4O2 (60 Da, AcOH) / C7H6O2 (122 Da, BzOH) / CH4O (32 Da, MeOH)

rules.description: C19-二萜生物碱六种亚型各具诊断性产物离子(DPI): cevanine, cevanine-七元环, jervine, veratramine, secosolanidine, solanidine类型
rules.reference: Wang et al., 2020 (Fritillaria steroidal alkaloids DPI)

rules.fragment_mz: DDA: aconitine 646→586(-AcOH)→526(-AcOH-BzOH)→105(benzoyl+); MDA: benzoylaconine 604→无60Da丢失; lipo: +fatty acid链
rules.description: 乌头碱类亚型区分: DDA(双酯型, 如aconitine/mesaconitine/hypaconitine): 首先丢失AcOH(60 Da, C8-乙酰基)→MDA→再丢失BzOH(122 Da, C14-苯甲酰基)→氨基醇。MDA(单酯型, 如benzoylaconine): 无60 Da丢失, 仅丢失BzOH(122)或MeOH(32)。Lipo-alkaloid(脂型): C8位为脂肪酸链(代替乙酰基), 丢失脂肪酸(14n+2 Da)。m/z 105.0340(C6H5CO+)为所有含C14-苯甲酰基乌头碱的通用诊断离子
rules.mechanism: DDA: 乙酰基→苯甲酰基→核心; MDA: 仅苯甲酰基; Lipo: 脂肪酸链
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失级联(DDA vs MDA vs Lipo区分)
rules.reference: PMID:26274911 C19-DAs fragmentation; Wiley JSSC 2021 DDA classification

rules.description: 可卡因类: 特征性丢失苯甲酸(C7H6O2, 122 Da)和苯甲酸甲酯片段
rules.reference: McLafferty & Turecek, 4th Ed.

subclasses.subclass: 吡咯里西啶类生物碱 (Pyrrolizidine Alkaloids)

rules.description: PA-N-氧化物在MS2中首先丢失H2O (18 Da)和O (16 Da)，N-氧化物可据此与游离碱区分

subclasses.subclass: 喹诺里西啶类生物碱 (Quinolizidine Alkaloids)

rules.reference: Wiley, DOI:10.1155/2011/652589; Russ. Chem. Rev.

rules.description: 苦参碱型生物碱: MS2产生m/z 150和m/z 136特征碎片，来自C环断裂
rules.reference: PMID literature on Sophora alkaloid MS

rules.description: 苦参碱(matrine, MW 248): m/z 249→150(C环断裂, 关键诊断)→136。氧化苦参碱(oxymatrine): 首先脱水m/z 265→247, 然后与苦参碱共享碎片m/z 150→136。N-氧化物脱水(-18 Da)为N-氧化物标志

rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(苦参碱型诊断)
rules.reference: EURL-Pesticides Matrine in Honey; PMID literature on Sophora alkaloid MS

rules.description: 槐果碱(sophocarpine, MW 245)碎片m/z 136(与苦参碱m/z 150差14); 槐定碱(sophoridine)碎片m/z 150(与苦参碱共享)。双键位置差异导致碎片位移
rules.mechanism: 喹诺里西啶骨架裂解(双键位置导向)
rules.reference: EURL-Pesticides Matrine in Honey; Wang et al., LC-MS/MS method

subclasses.core_description: 苯乙胺骨架, 含β-羟基和N-甲基

rules.mechanism: α-裂解 + 脱水 + 苄基重排
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(麻黄碱型)
rules.reference: PMC2582176; MDPI Molecules 2021, 26:6991

rules.description: 麻黄碱与伪麻黄碱的MRM转换相同(m/z 166→148, 脱水)，需通过色谱分离或离子淌度区分
rules.mechanism: 脱水(立体异构体碎片相同)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(异构体不可区分,需色谱)
rules.reference: MDPI Molecules 2021, 26:6991; LCMS.cz SelexION AppNote

classes.core_structure: C6-C3 (苯环+三碳侧链)

subclasses.core_description: C6-C3骨架, 侧链含羧基

rules.description: 羟基肉桂酸类以丢失CO2 (44 Da)为最特征碎片化反应
rules.reference: Parejo et al., 2004; Hossain et al., 2010; PMID:11199231

rules.description: 脱羧后进一步丢失CO (28 Da)，如咖啡酸m/z 135→107
绿原酸类(咖啡酰奎宁酸): 酯键断裂产生奎宁酸离子m/z 191(基峰)和咖啡酸离子m/z 179
rules.neutral_loss: C9H6O3 (162 Da, caffeoyl) / C7H12O6 (174 Da, quinic acid)
rules.reference: PMID:11199231; Clifford et al., 2003

rules.description: 绿原酸异构体(3-CQA, 4-CQA, 5-CQA)可通过m/z 191/179强度比及特征水丢失碎片区分
rules.reference: Clifford et al., 2003; PMID:12822898

rules.description: 绿原酸异构体MS/MS鉴别(均[M-H]- m/z 353): 3-CQA以m/z 191为主(咖啡酰丢失)而m/z 179(咖啡酸)弱; 4-CQA以m/z 173独有碎片为标志(奎宁酸-2H2O); 5-CQA: m/z 191为基峰,m/z 179也明显
rules.mechanism: 酰基位置导向的差异性裂解 — C3/C4/C5取代改变碎片丰度比
rules.diagnostic_type: 离子强度比(异构体鉴别)
rules.reference: Clifford et al., J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003; PMID:12822898; ScienceDirect Talanta 2016

rules.description: 绿原酸MS⁴层级鉴别: Clifford层级方案中m/z ~127(Q7碎片)和m/z ~172(Q4碎片)为位置异构体的高阶诊断碎片
rules.reference: Clifford et al., J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003; Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2006

rules.description: 绿原酸异构体区分(三者[M-H]-均为m/z 353.0878): 4-CQA是唯一产生强m/z 173碎片(奎宁酸脱水)的异构体, 因为C4位咖啡酰基促奎宁酸脱水。5-CQA谱图最简单: 仅m/z 191(基峰)和m/z 135, 几乎无m/z 179(因C5位酰化促进奎宁酸释放而非咖啡酸释放)。3-CQA同时产生m/z 191和179。RP-HPLC流出顺序: 3-CQA < 5-CQA < 4-CQA
rules.mechanism: 咖啡酰基位置导向差异性酯键断裂
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(4-CQA独有m/z 173; 5-CQA极简谱; 3-CQA双碎片)
rules.reference: Clifford et al., J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003, 51:2900; PMID:25426160; PMC4242998

subclasses.core_description: C6-C3侧链含醇/醛/烯

rules.fragment_mz: m/z 137 (苄基离子), m/z 151 (苯甲酰离子)
rules.description: 松柏醇及其苷/木脂素产生特征性m/z 137和m/z 151离子，对应氧化态不同的C6-C1碎片
rules.reference: Kurkin et al., 1994; Schmidt et al., various

rules.description: 丙-1-烯基苯丙素在CI中产生强[M+1-28]+离子(丢失C2H4)，可区分烯丙基/丙-1-烯基异构体
rules.reference: Lange & Schultze, 1992; Org. Mass Spectrom. 27:472

rules.description: 含邻位羟基/甲氧基的苯丙素(丁香酚、异丁香酚)在NH3/CI中形成突出[M+18]+加合离子
rules.reference: Lange & Schultze, 1992

subclasses.core_description: 苯并α-吡喃酮 (苯环+δ-内酯环), C6-C3内酯

rules.description: 香豆素以连续丢失CO2 (44 Da)和CO (28 Da)为特征，来自内酯环的降解
rules.reference: Shi et al., ESI-QE-Orbitrap MS/MS + DFT study; PMID:36721310

rules.description: 香豆素丢失CO (28 Da)，内酯环脱羰基
rules.reference: Shi et al.; PMID:36721310

rules.description: 呋喃香豆素亚型分类: C6-C7线型呋喃香豆素特征离子m/z 203.03和m/z 147.04; C7-C8角型呋喃香豆素特征离子m/z 131.05
rules.reference: Notopterygium coumarin study, Zhongguo Zhong Yao Za Zhi 2021

rules.description: 二氢呋喃香豆素特征离子m/z 187.04
rules.reference: Notopterygium coumarin study, Zhongguo Zhong Yao Za Zhi 2021

rules.description: 异戊烯基化香豆素丢失C4H8 (56 Da)异戊烯基
香豆素C-4位糖苷经McLafferty重排产生m/z 147, 119, 91特征离子
rules.reference: Zou et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2023

subclasses.core_description: C6-C3二聚体 (苯丙素二聚物)

rules.description: 二苄基丁内酯型木脂素以丢失CO2 (44 Da)为最诊断性特征（来自内酯环）
rules.reference: Schmidt et al., J. Mass Spectrom. 2008, 43:97-107; PMID:17729382

rules.description: 二苄基丁二醇型木脂素以丢失48 Da(甲醛+H2O)为特征
rules.reference: Schmidt et al., J. Mass Spectrom. 2008; PMID:17729382

rules.description: 木脂素糖苷首先丢失糖基产生苷元，然后苷元按上述规则裂解
rules.reference: Boldizsár et al., J. Chromatogr. A 2010; PMID:20045181

rules.description: Δ7,8-不饱和二苄基丁内酯木脂素(E/Z混合物)可通过特征MS/MS碎片区分结构异构体
rules.mechanism: 双键导向的差异性裂解
rules.reference: Schmidt et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2008

classes.core_structure: 异戊二烯单元 (C5H8)n 聚合体

subclasses.core_description: 两个异戊二烯单元

rules.description: 双环单萜(蒎烯型)以m/z 93为基峰(C7H9+二氢䓬鎓结构)，m/z 93/121比值可用于异构体区分
rules.mechanism: 双烯丙基C-C键断裂 + 重排
rules.reference: Enzell, Wahlberg & Ryhage, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 1984, 3:3

rules.description: 开链单萜经双烯丙基断裂产生特征碎片: 香叶醇→m/z 69(4,5-键断裂), 芳樟醇→m/z 71(5,6-键定向断裂)
rules.reference: Enzell, Wahlberg & Ryhage, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 1984, 3:3

subclasses.core_description: 三个异戊二烯单元

rules.description: 桉叶烷型和杜松烷型(十氢萘体系): RDA裂解占主导(无干扰官能团时)

rules.description: 没药烷型倍半萜: 苄基+烯丙基键断裂产生m/z 119, 83, 69等碎片
rules.reference: Enzell et al., Mass Spectrom. Rev. 1984, 3:3

subclasses.core_description: 四个异戊二烯单元

rules.description: 二萜类以连续丢失H2O (18 Da), CO2 (44 Da), HCOOH (46 Da)为常见中性丢失
rules.neutral_loss: H2O (18 Da) / CO2 (44 Da) / HCOOH (46 Da)
rules.reference: Enzell et al., Mass Spectrom. Rev. 1984, 3:3

rules.description: 新植二烯(开链二萜): McLafferty重排产生m/z 68基峰
rules.reference: Enzell et al., Mass Spectrom. Rev. 1984, 3:3

rules.fragment_mz: DDA: aconitine 646→586(-AcOH)→526(-AcOH-BzOH)→105(benzoyl+); MDA: benzoylaconine 604→无60Da丢失; lipo: +fatty acid链
rules.description: 乌头碱类亚型区分: DDA(双酯型, 如aconitine/mesaconitine/hypaconitine): 首先丢失AcOH(60 Da, C8-乙酰基)→MDA→再丢失BzOH(122 Da, C14-苯甲酰基)→氨基醇。MDA(单酯型, 如benzoylaconine): 无60 Da丢失, 仅丢失BzOH(122)或MeOH(32)。Lipo-alkaloid(脂型): C8位为脂肪酸链(代替乙酰基), 丢失脂肪酸(14n+2 Da)。m/z 105.0340(C6H5CO+)为所有含C14-苯甲酰基乌头碱的通用诊断离子
rules.mechanism: DDA: 乙酰基→苯甲酰基→核心; MDA: 仅苯甲酰基; Lipo: 脂肪酸链
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失级联(DDA vs MDA vs Lipo区分)
rules.reference: PMID:26274911 C19-DAs fragmentation; Wiley JSSC 2021 DDA classification

subclasses.core_description: 六个异戊二烯单元，五环/四环骨架

rules.description: Δ12-不饱和五环三萜(齐墩果烷/乌苏烷型)经C环RDA裂解产生特征性双烯和亲双烯体碎片
rules.reference: Gao et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2011; PMID:21503999

rules.description: 乌苏烷型C-3差向异构体区分: 3β-OH→ MS3中[M-H-H2O-HCOOH]- >> [M-H-H2O-CO2]-; 3α-OH→相反
rules.mechanism: C-3羟基空间导向差异性中性丢失
rules.reference: Gao et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2011; PMID:21503999

rules.description: 灵芝三萜: C-7/C-15羟基→D环裂解(b系列离子); C-15酮→C环裂解(a系列离子); C-7酮→双氢转移裂解(a+2/b+2离子)
rules.reference: Tanaka et al., Nat. Prod. Commun. 2011; Tan & Chen, J. Chromatogr. A 2008

rules.description: 三萜常见中性丢失: H2O (18 Da), CO2 (44 Da), HCOOH (46 Da), 及多种组合丢失
rules.reference: SciDirect 2026 review on triterpenoid LC-MS in TCM

rules.fragment_mz: 齐墩果烷型苷元 m/z 455; 乌苏烷型苷元 m/z 455; 白桦脂酸型 m/z 471→453
rules.description: 五环三萜苷元诊断离子汇总: 齐墩果酸/熊果酸 m/z 455[M+H]+; 常春藤皂苷元(hederagenin) m/z 471→453(-H2O); 蒲公英甾醇 m/z 473→455→437(连续脱水)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(五环三萜苷元分型)
rules.reference: Wiley PCA 2022; PMC6680687; Pulsatilla triterpenoid MS

subclasses.core_description: 三萜苷元+糖链

rules.description: 三萜皂苷从糖链末端顺序丢失单糖单元: 葡萄糖-162 Da, 葡萄糖醛酸-176 Da, 鼠李糖-146 Da, 阿拉伯糖-132 Da
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键顺序裂解 (Sequential glycosidic cleavage)
rules.reference: Tanaka et al., Nat. Prod. Commun. 2011; PMID:22224272

rules.description: 正离子模式中[M+NH4]+加合离子丢失NH3 (17 Da)比直接糖丢失更灵敏，可用于高通量筛查
rules.reference: Aims et al., Anal. Chim. Acta 2014; PMID:24528703

rules.description: 具11-氧代-12-烯结构的三萜皂苷产生特征性[sapogenin+H(H2O)n]+苷元碎片
rules.mechanism: 电荷定位效应 — 11-oxo-12-ene引导裂解
rules.reference: Tanaka et al., Nat. Prod. Commun. 2011

rules.description: 葡萄糖醛酸皂苷在CID中出现特征性糖醛酸交叉环裂解碎片
rules.mechanism: 糖醛酸交叉环裂解 (Cross-ring cleavage)
rules.reference: Tanaka et al., Nat. Prod. Commun. 2011

rules.fragment_mz: PPD型苷元 m/z 423.36; PPT型苷元 m/z 441.37/423.36
rules.description: 人参皂苷按苷元分型诊断: 原人参二醇型(PPD, 如Rb1/Rd)苷元离子m/z 423.36[M-H]-; 原人参三醇型(PPT, 如Re/Rg1)苷元离子m/z 441.37[M-H-H2O]-或m/z 423.36[进一步脱水]
rules.mechanism: 糖链顺序丢失 → 苷元骨架特征碎片
rules.neutral_loss: n×C6H10O5(162 Da Glc) / C6H10O4(146 Da Rha)

rules.description: PPD型人参皂苷特征级联(负离子): Rb1 [M-H]- m/z 1107→945(-Glc)→783(-Glc)→621(-Glc)→423(PPD苷元); Rd m/z 945→783→621→423
rules.reference: PMC10920005; LabRulez Ginsenoside AppNote; SCIEX Ginseng R&D Poster

rules.description: PPT型人参皂苷特征级联(负离子): Re [M-H]- m/z 945→783→637(丢失Rha+Glc); Rg1 m/z 801→639(-Glc)→477(-Glc)，苷元区m/z 441/423
rules.mechanism: 顺序糖丢失(PPT型苷元含C-6 OH使m/z较高)
rules.reference: PMC10920005; MDPI Molecules 2023, 28:941

rules.description: 人参皂苷Rd在MS3阶段产生二糖离子m/z 364.9，为葡萄糖-葡萄糖碎片，可用于确认糖链连接
rules.mechanism: 糖链内部断裂产生二糖oxonium离子
rules.reference: LabRulez Ginsenoside AppNote

rules.description: 甘草酸(glycyrrhizin)负离子特征级联: [M-H]- m/z 821→m/z 645(丢失1个葡萄糖醛酸176 Da)→m/z 469(丢失第2个葡萄糖醛酸)→m/z 351(RDA裂解碎片)
rules.mechanism: 双葡萄糖醛酸顺序丢失(176+176 Da) → 苷元RDA裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(葡萄糖醛酸皂苷)
rules.reference: ScienceDirect Microchemical J. 2010; ACS J. Nat. Prod. 2018

rules.description: 柴胡皂苷(saikosaponins, oleanane型)特征: 丢失30 Da(CH2O)为含环氧/醚桥柴胡皂苷的诊断性标志。苷元离子m/z 471→441(-30)。乙酰化柴胡皂苷另显示AcOH丢失(-60 Da)
rules.neutral_loss: CH2O (30 Da) / CH3COOH (60 Da, 乙酰化型)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(柴胡皂苷诊断)
rules.reference: PMC8514958; Frontiers in Chemistry 2021

rules.description: 黄芪皂苷(astragalosides, cycloartane型)负离子: Astragaloside IV [M-H]- m/z 783→651(-xylose 132 Da)→489(环黄芪醇苷元)。苷元脱水碎片m/z 471
rules.mechanism: 顺序糖丢失(xyl→glc) → 环黄芪醇苷元
rules.reference: MDPI Molecules 2024, 29(6):1295; PMC8965511

rules.description: 甘草酸(glycyrrhizin)特征: [M-H]- 821.4→645.4(丢失第一个葡萄糖醛酸GlcA, 176.0321 Da)→469.3(丢失第二个GlcA, 苷元glycyrrhetinic acid)→351.1(双葡萄糖醛酸碎片)。m/z 193.0为单GlcA碎片。astragaloside IV: 807[+Na]→621(-Xyl 132)→473(-Glc 162, 苷元cycloastragenol)
rules.mechanism: 葡萄糖醛酸/糖基顺序丢失
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(甘草酸/黄芪甲苷特异性)
rules.reference: PMID:15639440 glycyrrhizin LC-MS/MS; PMC10974181 saponin characterization 2024

rules.description: 人参皂苷苷元诊断: PPD型(protopanaxadiol)苷元m/z 459.4; PPT型(protopanaxatriol)苷元m/z 475.4。PPD vs PPT由苷元m/z差16 Da(一个OH)区分。Rb1(PPD, 4个Glc): 1107→945→783→621→459。Rg1(PPT, 2个Glc): 799→637→475。Notoginsenoside R1(PPT): 931→799(-Xyl 132)→637(-Glc)。糖丢失顺序: 外侧糖优先断裂
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键从外侧向内侧顺序断裂 → PPD/PPT苷元
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(PPD苷元m/z 459 vs PPT苷元m/z 475)
rules.reference: PMC10920005 ginsenoside profiling; PMC6268376 Panax notoginseng saponins

subclasses.core_description: 八个异戊二烯单元, 共轭多烯长链

rules.description: APCI正离子模式下类胡萝卜素主要形成[M]+和[M+H]+。CID-MS/MS中按端基结构裂解
rules.reference: PMC3293484; Rivera-Madrid et al., APCI-MS/MS of carotenoids

rules.description: β-胡萝卜素特征碎片: m/z 444 (丢失C10H16, 136 Da), m/z 430 (丢失C11H18, 150 Da), m/z 369 (连续裂解)
rules.reference: PMC3293484; Univ. Lleida carotenoid MS review

rules.description: 类胡萝卜素环化端基决定碎片模式: β环→m/z 444/430; ε环→特征性m/z差异; 无环(番茄红素)→不同裂解路径

rules.reference: IntechOpen 2019; carotenoid MS developments

rules.description: 叶黄素(含OH)经多次丢失H2O后产生m/z 92.5碎片，用于区分含氧与不含氧类胡萝卜素
rules.mechanism: 连续脱水 + 骨架裂解
rules.reference: Univ. Lleida carotenoid MS review; MDPI Molecules 2019, 24, 4517

subclasses.core_description: C40多烯化合物(8个异戊二烯单元), 含/不含环己烯端环

rules.fragment_mz: β-carotene [M+H]+ 537→137(β-ionone, 基峰)→413; lycopene: 537→467(-isoprene, 基峰); α-carotene: 537→123(α-ionone, 区分β); lutein [M+H]+ 569→135→495(-H2O-RDA)
rules.description: 类胡萝卜素以APCI离子化为佳(ESI灵敏度低)。β-carotene: β-ionone碎片m/z 137为基峰。lycopene: m/z 467(-C5H8 isoprene)为基峰, 区别于β-carotene。α-carotene vs β-carotene: α有独有DFI m/z 123(α-ionone)。lutein vs zeaxanthin: lutein有独有m/z 495(-H2O-RDA)和m/z 430(-α-ionone)。中性丢失: toluene(92), xylene(106), isoprene(68)
rules.mechanism: 多烯链消除 (toluene/xylene/isoprene) + 端环离子(ionone碎片)
rules.neutral_loss: C7H8 (92, toluene) / C5H8 (68, isoprene) / C8H10 (106, xylene)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(端环ionone诊断, 区分胡萝卜素异构体)
rules.reference: van Breemen et al., Int. J. Mass Spectrom. 2012, 312:163-172; PMID:22408388; PMC3293484

classes.core_structure: 9,10-蒽醌母核 (三环二酮)

rules.description: 蒽醌类以丢失CO (28 Da，来自醌羰基)为最特征中性丢失
rules.reference: Ma et al., J. Hubei Univ. (Nat. Sci.) 2006

rules.description: 蒽醌类丢失CO2 (44 Da)经重排反应产生
rules.reference: Dong et al., HPLC/ESI-IT-TOF MS of Polygonum cuspidatum

rules.description: 蒽醌经中央醌环RDA裂解为特征，但通常被CO/CO2丢失优势所掩盖
rules.reference: Ma et al., J. Hubei Univ. 2006

rules.description: 大黄素(emodin, MW 270): [M-H]- m/z 269 → m/z 241(CO丢失) → m/z 225(CO2丢失)
大黄酸(rhein, MW 284): [M-H]- m/z 283 → m/z 257(CO丢失) → m/z 239(H2O丢失) → 特征羧基定向裂解
大黄酚(chrysophanol): [M-H]- m/z 253 → m/z 225(CO丢失)
大黄素甲醚(physcion): [M-H]- m/z 283 → m/z 240(特征碎片)
蒽醌类在负离子ESI中产生强[M-H]-基峰，通常不形成二聚体或加合离子
rules.mechanism: 负离子模式选择性离子化
rules.reference: Ma et al., J. Hubei Univ. 2006

classes.core_structure: 环戊烷并多氢菲 (四环骨架 A-B-C-D)

subclasses.core_description: 3-羟基甾体, C17脂肪侧链

rules.description: 甾醇C17侧链裂解: 不饱和侧链产生m/z 257(丢失侧链+2H+甲基迁移); McLafferty重排产生m/z 300
rules.mechanism: 侧链裂解 + 甲基迁移/McLafferty重排
rules.reference: Björkhem & Gustafsson, Org. Mass Spectrom. 1973; PMID:1154458

rules.description: Δ7甾醇: m/z 257 > m/z 300; Δ5甾醇: m/z 300 > m/z 257 (诊断性比值规则)
rules.mechanism: 双键位置导向的裂解偏好
rules.reference: Björkhem & Gustafsson, Org. Mass Spectrom. 1973

subclasses.core_description: 螺甾烷/呋甾烷母核+糖链

rules.description: 甾体皂苷以顺序糖丢失为主(同三萜皂苷)，螺甾烷型皂苷因F环稳定性产生特征性苷元碎片
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键顺序裂解 → 苷元裂解
rules.reference: Challinor & De Voss, Steroids 2011; MDPI Molecules 2023, 28, 705

rules.description: 甾体皂苷ESI-QqTOF-MS/MS中可观察到鼠李糖优先丢失(146 Da)，用于推断糖链连接顺序
rules.reference: Wiley J. Mass Spectrom. 2005; DOI:10.1002/jms.988

subclasses.core_description: 甾体母核+C17五元/六元不饱和内酯环+糖链

rules.description: 强心苷特征性连续丢失洋地黄毒糖单元(各146 Da, 脱氧己糖)后产生苷元碎片
rules.reference: Ravi et al., Data in Brief 2020; PMC7153291; PMID:32300626

rules.description: 洋地黄毒苷元(digitoxigenin)的三个特征碎片m/z 375→357→339，为连续脱水产物(2个OH)
rules.reference: Ravi et al., Data in Brief 2020; PMC7153291

rules.description: 地高辛苷元(digoxigenin)四个特征碎片: 连续脱水三次(3个OH)，为C12-OH洋地黄毒苷元标志
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(苷元亚型诊断)
rules.reference: Ravi et al., Data in Brief 2020; PMC7153291

rules.fragment_mz: digitoxose m/z 131.0703; glucose m/z 145.1012; fucose m/z 129.0546
rules.description: 强心苷糖单元碎片: digitoxose m/z 131, acetyldigitoxose m/z 173, digitalose m/z 161, glucose m/z 145, fucose m/z 129
rules.reference: Ravi et al., Data in Brief 2020; PMC7153291

classes.core_structure: 多酚类大分子(可水解鞣质)或多聚黄烷-3-醇(缩合鞣质)

subclasses.core_description: 没食子酸/鞣花酸与葡萄糖酯化
example_compounds: 五没食子酰葡萄糖 Pentagalloylglucose

rules.fragment_mz: m/z 169.014 (没食子酸), m/z 125.024 (脱羧没食子酸)
rules.description: 含没食子酰基的可水解鞣质产生m/z 169 (没食子酸负离子) 及m/z 125 (脱CO2) 特征碎片
rules.mechanism: 酯键断裂 → 没食子酸 → 脱羧
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.description: 含HHDP(六羟基联苯二甲酰基)的鞣花鞣质产生m/z 301(鞣花酸，源自HHDP自发内酯化)及m/z 275, 249系列碎片
rules.mechanism: HHDP自发性内酯化 → 鞣花酸 → 连续脱羧
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(负离子, HHDP标志)
rules.reference: J. Agric. Food Chem. 2007, 55:143; Engström & Karonen, 2026

rules.description: 大分子可水解鞣质常见[M-2H]2-双电荷离子(如五没食子酰葡萄糖)
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2026

subclasses.core_description: 黄烷-3-醇单元经C-C键聚合

rules.description: 缩合鞣质的特征性单体碎片m/z 289 (儿茶素/表儿茶素负离子)，为QM(醌甲基化物)裂解的产物
rules.mechanism: 醌甲基化物裂解 (Quinone Methide cleavage, 黄烷键间C-C键断裂)
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.description: 缩合鞣质RDA裂解产生m/z 425碎片(丢失152 Da, C8H8O3)，进一步脱水得m/z 407
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.description: 缩合鞣质杂环裂解(HRF)产生m/z 451特征碎片(丢失126 Da)
rules.mechanism: 杂环裂解 (Heterocyclic Ring Fission, HRF)
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.description: B型原花青素产生m/z 287特征碎片(脱氢延伸单元标志)，用于DP判定
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(延伸单元标志)
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.description: B型原花青素二聚体[M-H]- m/z 577和三聚体[M-H]- m/z 865为确认性分子离子
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, 2026; PMID:41307161

rules.fragment_mz: A型二聚体 [M-H]- m/z 575; B型二聚体 [M-H]- m/z 577
rules.description: 原花青素A型vs B型鉴别: A型含额外C2-O-C7醚键使分子比B型轻2Da。A型二聚体m/z 575, B型二聚体m/z 577
rules.mechanism: 分子量差异(2Da) — 额外醚键使A型减少2个H
rules.reference: PMC5891158; ResearchGate A-type procyanidin MS/MS

rules.fragment_mz: A型: QM裂解产生m/z 449(-126)+m/z 287; B型: QM裂解产生m/z 289(单体)
rules.description: A型原花青素QM裂解受额外醚键约束产生独特碎片: A型二聚体→m/z 449(丢失126 Da, C6H6O3)和m/z 287(脱氢单体); B型→m/z 289(正常单体)
rules.mechanism: QM裂解(醚键约束使A型碎片不同)
rules.neutral_loss: A型: C6H6O3(126 Da); B型: C8H8O3(152 Da, RDA)
rules.reference: PMC5891158; ResearchGate fragmentation pathway A-type dimer

rules.fragment_mz: 延伸单元碎片 m/z 287(A型)/289(B型)
rules.description: 缩合鞣质聚合度(DP)判定: 终端单元碎片m/z 289(儿茶素)和延伸单元碎片m/z 287(脱氢儿茶素)。A型延伸单元对应m/z 285(多脱2H)
rules.mechanism: QM裂解区分终端/延伸单元
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(聚合度+类型诊断)
rules.reference: Engström & Karonen, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2026; PMID:41307161

subclasses.core_description: 间苯三酚(phloroglucinol)低聚物, C-C或C-O-C连接

rules.fragment_mz: 间苯三酚单体: m/z 125 [C6H5O3]-; 丢失间苯三酚单元: -124 Da (C6H4O2)
rules.description: 褐藻多酚以间苯三酚单体离子m/z 125为通用DFI。MS/MS产生顺序丢失间苯三酚单元(124 Da, C6H4O2, 脱水后)。fucols(C-C连接): 丢失C6H4O2(124); phlorethols(C-O-C连接): 丢失C6H6O3(126); eckols(1,4-二噁英连接): 特征碎片。分子量范围371-6000+ Da
rules.mechanism: 间苯三酚单元顺序丢失
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 125, DFI) + 中性丢失(间苯三酚单元)
rules.reference: PMC7795173 phlorotannins Saccharina; MDPI Foods 2023, 12:3000; ACS J Agric Food Chem 2012

classes.core_structure: 含羧基的小分子有机酸 (C6-C1苯甲酸型 / C6-C3肉桂酸型 / 脂肪族)

subclasses.core_description: C6-C1骨架, 苯环+羧基

rules.description: 对羟基苯甲酸类以丢失CO2 (44 Da)为诊断性中性丢失(负离子模式)
rules.reference: Parejo et al., 2004; Hossain et al., 2010; PMID:19702859

rules.description: 对羟基苯甲酸同时出现CO (28 Da)和CO2 (44 Da)两种丢失
rules.reference: Luo et al., 2020; Kang et al., 2016

rules.description: 邻位效应—龙胆酸和2,3,4-三羟基苯甲酸因邻位取代基相互作用不走常规CO2丢失路径
rules.reference: Robbins, J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003 (review)

subclasses.core_description: C6-C3骨架 (同上苯丙酸类)

rules.description: 同苯丙酸类规则PPA-001: 肉桂酸型以CO2丢失为主要诊断特征
rules.reference: Parejo et al., 2004; Hossain et al., 2010

rules.description: 迷迭香酸(m/z 359 [M-H]-): 特征碎片m/z 161, 179, 197(咖啡酸来源)
rules.reference: PMID literature on rosmarinic acid MS

subclasses.subclass: 脂肪族有机酸 (Aliphatic Organic Acids)
subclasses.core_description: 直链/支链二羧酸/三羧酸

rules.fragment_mz: m/z 191 (柠檬酸脱水), m/z 111 (二次脱水)
rules.description: 柠檬酸([M-H]- m/z 191): m/z 111 (丢失CO2+H2O, 62 Da), m/z 87
rules.reference: HMDB; general MS databases

rules.description: 奎宁酸([M-H]- m/z 191): m/z 191为绿原酸类化合物最可靠的特征碎片之一
rules.mechanism: 奎宁酸母离子/特征碎片
rules.reference: Clifford et al., 2003; PMID:12822898

classes.core_structure: 二苯并-γ-吡喃酮 (xanthone nucleus, C13H8O2)

rules.description: 未取代山酮的分子离子为基峰(EI-MS)，其母核异常稳定，不进行RDA裂解(区别于黄酮)
rules.diagnostic_type: 母离子稳定性(阴性诊断)
rules.reference: Comprehensive Heterocyclic Chemistry; Drewes, Chroman and Related Compounds

rules.description: 山酮特征性脱羰基级联: M+ → [M-CO]+ (m/z 168) → [M-CO-CO]+ (m/z 140) → [M-CO-CO-H]+ (m/z 139)
rules.mechanism: 连续脱羰基 (Sequential CO extrusion → dibenzofuran ion)
rules.reference: Comprehensive Heterocyclic Chemistry; Drewes

rules.description: 羟基山酮(ESI+): 基峰通常为[M+H-46]+(丢失H2O+CO), 是所有具生物活性多羟基山酮的最丰富产物离子
rules.mechanism: 质子化羰基→邻位羟基脱水→CO消除
rules.reference: Silva et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2016; PMID:27472302

rules.description: [M+H-64]+碎片(丢失46→18)为含儿茶酚基团山酮的独占性诊断碎片，与强抗氧化活性呈正相关
rules.reference: Silva et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2016; PMID:27472302

rules.description: [M+H-44]+ (CO+O丢失) 仅出现于非取代和对位-OH取代山酮，提示低或无生物活性
rules.reference: Silva et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2016; PMID:27472302

rules.description: 山酮C-苷(如芒果苷)主要经糖基交叉环裂解断裂: 产生-120 Da和-149 Da碎片，而非山酮母核裂解
rules.reference: Mangiferin MS literature

classes.core_structure: C6-C2-C6 (1,2-二苯乙烯骨架)

rules.description: 二苯乙烯类经MALDI/ESI裂解可丢失C2H2O (42 Da)，来自乙烯桥的重排裂解
rules.reference: PMID literature on stilbenoid MS

rules.description: 白藜芦醇([M-H]- m/z 227): m/z 185 (丢失C2H2O), m/z 143 (丢失2×C2H2O)
rules.reference: Resveratrol MS literature; MoNA spectral data

rules.description: 二苯乙烯苷(如虎杖苷): 首先丢失葡萄糖(162 Da)生成白藜芦醇苷元，然后按STI-002裂解
rules.reference: Polydatin MS literature

classes.core_structure: 环戊烷[c]吡喃环系统 (iridoid nucleus) 或开环型 (secoiridoid)

rules.description: 环烯醚萜苷首先丢失葡萄糖(162 Da)生成苷元
rules.reference: Zeng et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2014; PMID:24911243

rules.description: 环烯醚萜苷元进一步丢失H2O (18 Da), CO2 (44 Da), CH3OH (32 Da)等
rules.reference: Zeng et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2014; PMID:24911243

rules.description: 裂环环烯醚萜苷(如龙胆苦苷)苷元裂解特征: CO2丢失+脱水产生级联碎片
rules.mechanism: 开环骨架重排+连续中性丢失
rules.reference: Zeng et al., Rapid Commun. Mass Spectrom. 2014; PMID:24911243

rules.description: 橄榄苦苷(裂环环烯醚萜): m/z 539→377(丢葡萄糖)→307(丢C3H2O2)→275(丢CH3OH)
rules.mechanism: 糖丢失→开环降解→脱甲醇
rules.reference: Oleuropein MS literature; MoNA spectral data

classes.core_structure: 含氰基(CN)的糖苷

rules.description: 氰苷经糖丢失后苷元进一步丢失HCN (27 Da)，为氰苷特征
rules.reference: PMID literature on amygdalin MS

classes.core_structure: 含硫官能团(硫苷, 二硫键, 异硫氰酸酯等)

rules.description: 芥子油苷(glucosinolates): 负离子模式以丢失SO3 (80 Da)为特征
rules.reference: Glucosinolate MS literature; MoNA spectral data

rules.description: 芥子油苷同时丢失葡萄糖(162 Da)，与SO3丢失竞争
rules.reference: Glucosinolate MS literature

classes.core_structure: 苯乙醇(C6-C2)苷元+糖链(常含咖啡酰基)

rules.description: 苯乙醇苷类特征性中性丢失: 鼠李糖(146 Da), 咖啡酰基(162 Da), 葡萄糖(162 Da), 及其组合(308 Da)
rules.neutral_loss: C6H10O4 (146, Rha) / C6H10O5 (162, Glc) / C9H6O3 (162, caffeoyl) / C15H16O7 (308, Rha+Glc)
rules.reference: Acteoside/verbascoside MS literature

rules.description: 毛蕊花糖苷(m/z 623 [M-H]-): 基峰m/z 461 (丢咖啡酰162 Da)
rules.reference: Acteoside MS literature; MoNA spectral data

classes.core_structure: 嘌呤母核 (C5H4N4)

rules.description: 黄嘌呤生物碱以连续丢失CH3NCO (57 Da, 甲基异氰酸酯)和CO (28 Da)为特征
rules.reference: MS literature on methylxanthines; MoNA spectral data

classes.core_structure: 嘌呤/嘧啶碱基 + 戊糖 + 磷酸(核苷酸)

rules.description: 核苷以糖苷键断裂(N9-C1'或N1-C1')产生碱基碎片为特征: 腺嘌呤m/z 136, 鸟嘌呤m/z 152, 尿嘧啶m/z 113, 胞嘧啶m/z 112
rules.reference: ACS Chem. Rev. 2005; PMID:15826020; HMDB

rules.description: 核苷酸(如AMP)以丢失H3PO4 (98 Da)或HPO3 (80 Da)为特征，产生相应核苷碎片
rules.reference: ACS Chem. Rev. 2005; PMID:15826020

rules.description: 核苷在正离子模式常首先脱水(-18 Da)，来自核糖环脱水
rules.reference: HMDB; general nucleoside MS literature

rules.description: 核苷糖苷键断裂产生碱基离子为基峰或强峰: 腺嘌呤[MH-132]+, 鸟嘌呤[MH-132]+, 尿嘧啶[MH-132]+
rules.mechanism: N-糖苷键断裂 — 碱基离子
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(碱基类型鉴别)
rules.reference: HMDB; general nucleoside MS literature

classes.core_structure: 长链脂肪族羧酸 (CnH2n+1COOH) 及其甘油酯衍生物

rules.description: 磷脂酰胆碱(PC)在正离子ESI中产生特征性胆碱头部碎片m/z 184.073 (C5H14NO4P)，为PC专属诊断离子
rules.mechanism: 磷脂头部基团断裂 (Head-group fragmentation)
rules.reference: RSC Anal. Methods 2016; PMC3117083; LIPID MAPS

rules.description: PC在正离子MS2中可丢失磷酸胆碱头部(C5H14NO4P, 183 Da，或以[M+H-141]+形式出现，取决于加合离子)
rules.mechanism: 磷酸胆碱头部中性丢失
rules.reference: LIPID MAPS; RSC Anal. Methods 2016

rules.description: 甘油磷脂在负离子CID中以丢失脂肪酸酰基(RCOOH)为特征: 每个酰基丢失对应游离脂肪酸的分子量
rules.neutral_loss: 取决于脂肪酸链 (如 C16:0 = 256 Da, C18:1 = 282 Da)
rules.reference: RSC Anal. Methods 2016; PMC3117083; J. Lipid Res.

rules.description: 游离脂肪酸在负离子ESI中产生[M-H]-母离子，CID碎片以丢失CO2 (44 Da)和H2O (18 Da)为特征
rules.reference: LIPID MAPS; LipidWeb

rules.description: 磷脂CID产生脂肪酸酰基负离子(如m/z 255.233 C16:0, m/z 281.248 C18:1)，可直接推断酰基链组成
rules.mechanism: sn位酯键断裂 — 酰基离子
rules.reference: RSC Anal. Methods 2016; Wiley RCM 2023

classes.core_structure: 苷元 + 糖基 (O-苷/C-苷/S-苷/N-苷)

rules.description: O-苷类糖基中性丢失质量规则: 己糖(hexose)-162 Da, 脱氧己糖(deoxyhexose)-146 Da, 戊糖(pentose)-132 Da, 葡萄糖醛酸(glucuronic acid)-176 Da, 半乳糖醛酸(galacturonic acid)-176 Da
rules.reference: Cuyckens & Claeys, 2004; PMID:15389856

rules.description: C-苷类糖环交叉环裂解规则: 产生-60 Da (0,2X), -90 Da (0,3X), -120 Da (0,4X) 碎片序列，不丢失完整糖基
rules.mechanism: C-糖苷糖环交叉环裂解 (Cross-ring cleavage)

rules.description: 寡糖苷中糖链从末端顺序丢失(外向内裂解)，可推断糖链连接顺序
O-苷产生Y0-苷元离子(丢失全部糖链)，从Y0离子质量可直接推断苷元分子量
rules.reference: ScienceDirect 2021 TCM MS/MS review; PMID:16418439

rules.description: 糖oxonium离子: 己糖m/z 161(0,2X+)或m/z 179, 脱氧己糖m/z 145, 戊糖m/z 131，用于鉴定糖类型
rules.reference: Alves et al., RSC Adv. 2024; PMC10985591

classes.core_structure: 苯并呋喃-2(3H)-酮 (苯酞内酯母核, C8H6O2)

rules.description: 藁本内酯(Z-ligustilide, MW 190)正离子级联: m/z 191→173(脱水,最高强度)→161→133(苯酞鎓离子,丢失C4H9)→105(苯甲酰离子)
rules.mechanism: 脱水→脱羰基→烷基链丢失
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片级联(苯酞母核诊断)
rules.reference: PMC6272380; PMC6268525; Lao et al., Anal. Chim. Acta 2004

rules.description: 丁烯基苯酞MRM特征离子: m/z 149(Z/E异构体通用碎片)。丁基苯酞EI: m/z 133(苯酞鎓, 丢失C4H9)和m/z 105(C6H5CO+)
rules.mechanism: 侧链丢失 → 苯酞鎓离子
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(苯酞侧链诊断)
rules.reference: PMC6268525; Lao et al., 2004

rules.description: 洋川芎内酯A(Senkyunolide A, MW 192, 含OH)特征: 连续脱水m/z 193→175→157，羟基取代使脱水主导
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(羟基苯酞诊断)
rules.reference: PMC6272380; Wei et al., Molecules 2015

classes.core_structure: 含羧基的小分子有机酸 (C6-C1苯甲酸型 / C6-C3肉桂酸型 / 脂肪族)

subclasses.core_description: C6-C1骨架, 苯环+羧基

rules.description: 对羟基苯甲酸类以丢失CO2 (44 Da)为诊断性中性丢失(负离子模式)。邻位羟基(水杨酸, 没食子酸等)可能因邻位效应改变裂解路径
rules.reference: Parejo et al., 2004; Hossain et al., 2010; Robbins, J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003; PMID:19702859

subclasses.subclass: 脂肪族有机酸 (Aliphatic Organic Acids)
subclasses.core_description: 直链/支链二羧酸/三羧酸

rules.description: 脂肪族二羧酸/三羧酸以连续脱水和脱羧为特征。柠檬酸: -H2O→-CO2→-H2O级联。特征碎片m/z 45 (HCOO-), m/z 59 (CH3COO-)为羧酸通用诊断离子
rules.reference: Grossert et al., J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 2007; HMDB

classes.core_structure: 嘌呤/嘧啶碱基+核糖/脱氧核糖

rules.description: 核苷以丢失核糖(132 Da, C5H8O4)或脱氧核糖(116 Da)为特征，产生碱基离子。碱基进一步丢失NH3 (17 Da), HCN (27 Da), CO (28 Da)等小分子
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键断裂→碱基碎片→小分子中性丢失
rules.neutral_loss: C5H8O4 (132, ribose) / C5H8O3 (116, deoxyribose) / NH3 (17) / HCN (27)
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失+特征碱基碎片
rules.reference: HMDB; MassBank; general nucleoside MS literature

classes.core_structure: 长链羧酸(R-COOH) / 甘油酯骨架(glycerol + fatty acyl chains)

subclasses.core_description: 长链一元羧酸, 饱和/不饱和/羟基化/环氧

rules.description: 脂肪酸在负离子ESI中以[M-H]-为基峰。CID裂解以丢失CO2 (44 Da, 脱羧)为最特征反应。不饱和脂肪酸另有电荷远程裂解(charge-remote fragmentation)产生间隔14 Da (CH2)的碎片系列
rules.mechanism: 脱羧反应 (Decarboxylation) + 电荷远程裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(脱羧, 负离子)
rules.reference: Christie WW. Lipid Analysis, 4th Ed., 2010; Murphy et al., J. Lipid Res. 2005; PMID:16024739

rules.description: 羟基脂肪酸以连续脱水为特征: [M-H]- → [M-H-H2O]- → [M-H-2H2O]-。环氧脂肪酸(如EETs)特征性开环产生m/z 155, 191碎片。PUFAs产生特征性间隔24 Da碎片(双键间隔诊断)
rules.mechanism: 脱水级联 / 环氧开环 / 双键定位碎片
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(氧化脂肪酸诊断)
rules.reference: Yang et al., J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 2011; PMID:21331402; JLR 2023, PUFA fragmentation

subclasses.core_description: 甘油骨架+3条脂肪酰链

rules.description: TAGs以[M+NH4]+加合离子为特征。CID裂解优先从sn-1/sn-3位丢失RCOOH(脂肪酸中性丢失), sn-2位丢失最不优先。[M+NH4]+ → -NH3 → -RCOOH → [DAG]+ 碎片。sn-1/sn-3 vs sn-2: 产物离子丰度比可区分位置异构体
rules.mechanism: 铵加合离子中性丢失 (NH3 + RCOOH)
rules.reference: Hsu & Turk, J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 1999; PMID:23378093; LIPID MAPS methods chapters

classes.core_structure: 1,4-萘醌母核 (1,4-naphthoquinone, C10H6O2)

rules.description: 1,4-萘醌类以连续丢失CO (28 Da)和CO2 (44 Da)为特征, 与蒽醌类似但碎片m/z更低。羟基萘醌优先丢失CO2(邻位羟基辅助)。甲基萘醌(白花丹素)另丢失CH3 (15 Da)。级联: [M-H]- → -CO2 → -CO → -CO
rules.mechanism: 醌羰基脱羧+脱羰基级联
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失级联(萘醌诊断)
rules.reference: Frontiers Plant Sci. 2021; PMC7830255; Guo et al., Anal. Sci. 2007

rules.description: 紫草素类(萘醌+异己烯基侧链)诊断碎片: m/z 270(H2O丢失), m/z 218.02(萘醌核心碎片, 丢失侧链), m/z 190.03(218-CO)。m/z 218.02和190.03为紫草素衍生物的通用诊断碎片(DFIs)
rules.mechanism: 侧链消除+萘醌核心脱羰基
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(紫草素类DFI, 负离子)
rules.reference: PMC9104353; MDPI Molecules 2025, 31:1434; Phytochem. Analysis systematic NQ ID

rules.description: 维生素K类(2-甲基-3-植醇基-1,4-萘醌): 以丢失植醇侧链为特征(丢失C20H40, 280 Da范围)。核心碎片m/z 187为甲基萘醌离子。泛醌(CoQ): 丢失各异戊烯基侧链单元(各68 Da, C5H8)
rules.mechanism: 异戊烯基侧链消除 + 萘醌核心碎片
rules.reference: Ham & Gross, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2004; Grossert et al., J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 2007

classes.core_structure: 甘油磷脂骨架 (glycerophospholipid backbone: glycerol + phosphate + head group + 2 fatty acyl chains)

subclasses.core_description: 甘油骨架 + 磷酸胆碱头基 + 2脂肪酰链

rules.description: PC在正离子ESI中产生诊断性m/z 184.0733离子(磷酸胆碱头基, [C5H15NO4P]+), 为PC/LPC/SM的通用诊断离子。另: 中性丢失183 Da(磷酸胆碱)和59 Da(三甲胺, N(CH3)3)。正离子PIS m/z 184可筛查所有含胆碱磷脂
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 184) + 中性丢失
rules.reference: Pulfer & Murphy, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2003; PMID:12691095; LIPID MAPS; RSC Anal. Methods 2016

subclasses.core_description: 甘油骨架 + 磷酸乙醇胺头基 + 2脂肪酰链

rules.description: PE在正离子中以中性丢失141.019 Da(磷酸乙醇胺头基)为特征诊断。产生[DAG]+型碎片离子。负离子模式: m/z 196.038(glycerophosphoethanolamine-H2O), m/z 140.012(ethanolamine phosphate)。NLS 141可筛查所有PE
rules.mechanism: 头基中性丢失 (Head group NL)
rules.reference: Brugger et al., PNAS 1997; PMID:11562469; IntechOpen phospholipid MS chapter

subclasses.subclass: 其他磷脂 (PI, PS, PG, PA)
subclasses.core_description: 不同头基的甘油磷脂

rules.description: PI负离子: m/z 241.012(肌醇磷酸, inositol phosphate)为诊断离子; PS正离子: NL 87 Da(丝氨酸头基); PG负离子: m/z 171.006(甘油磷酸)为诊断; PA负离子: m/z 152.996(甘油磷酸-H2O)及NL 98(H3PO4)
rules.mechanism: 头基特征碎片 (Class-specific headgroup ions)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(磷脂亚类区分)
rules.reference: PMC7070507; LIPID MAPS methods; RSC Anal. Methods 2016; PMID:16557496

classes.core_structure: 酰胺键连接的芳香酸胺类 (aromatic acid-amine via amide bond)

rules.fragment_mz: 胡椒碱: [M+H]+ 286→201(piperoyl acylium, 丢piperidine 85 Da)→173(-CO); 辣椒素: 306→137(vanillylamine cation, DFI); piperlongumine: 318→221(trimethoxycinnamoyl acylium)
rules.description: 酰胺类生物碱以酰胺键(N-CO)α-断裂为最主导裂解途径。质子化优先发生在酰胺N上(经DFT计算证实), 促进N-CO键断裂。胡椒碱: [M+H]+ 286→201(piperoyl acylium, C12H10O3+, 丢失piperidine 85 Da)→173(-CO)→143; 辣椒素: 306→137(vanillylamine cation, C8H9O2+, 通用诊断离子, PIS扫描用); piperlongumine: 318→221(trimethoxycinnamoyl acylium)→193(-CO)
rules.mechanism: 酰胺键α-断裂 (N-CO bond cleavage, 质子化N导向)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(酰胺键断裂产物)
rules.reference: Fokoue et al., RSC Adv. 2018, 8:21407; PMC9080946; PMID:30668887

rules.fragment_mz: N-p-coumaroyltyramine: 284→147(香豆酰鎓离子, coumaroyl acylium)→121(酪胺碎片, tyramine)
rules.description: 羟基肉桂酸酰胺(HCAA)以酰胺键断裂产生两个互补碎片: 酰基碎片(acylium)和胺碎片。N-p-香豆酰酪胺: 284→147(coumaroyl acylium, C9H7O2+)→121(tyramine, C8H9O+)→119(-H2O)。咖啡酰酪胺: 284→163(caffeoyl acylium)。此互补碎片对为HCAA结构鉴定的关键
rules.mechanism: 酰胺键断裂 → 酰基碎片 + 胺碎片
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(互补诊断离子对)
rules.reference: ACS Anal. Chem. 2018, deep annotation of HCAAs; PMC10535375; PMID:30668887

classes.core_structure: 1-羟基甲基吡咯里西啶necine碱基(necine base) + necic酸酯

rules.fragment_mz: retronecine型DFI: m/z 138(C8H12NO+, 质子化retronecine, 基峰), 120(138-H2O), 94; 饱和型: m/z 140, 122; otonecine型: m/z 168, 150
rules.description: PAs特征裂解: 酯键断裂产生necine碱基碎片和necic酸碎片。1,2-不饱和PAs(retronecine/heliotridine型): 诊断碎片m/z 138(protonated retronecine, 基峰级)和m/z 120(138-H2O)及m/z 94; 饱和PAs(platynecine型): m/z 140, 122; otonecine型: m/z 168, 150。heliotrine特征碎片: m/z 214, 197, 156
rules.mechanism: 酯键断裂 (Ester bond cleavage → necine base fragments)
rules.reference: MJCCE fragmentation patterns of PAs; PMC8610691; Nature 2025 HR-MS/MS library of 165 PA spectra

rules.description: 大环二酯PAs(如senecionine): 丢失两个酯基产生碱基碎片m/z 138。单酯PAs: 仅一个酯键断裂。N-氧化物PAs(PANOs): 特征性丢失O (16 Da)转化为游离碱。HRMS数据库已建立165个PA/PANO光谱。PA分类: retronecine型(1,2-unsat, m/z 138) vs heliotridine型(7S epimer, m/z 214) vs otonecine型(m/z 168) vs saturated型(m/z 140)
rules.reference: Nature 2025, 84 PA standards HRMS; Agilent 28 PA LC-MS/MS method; PMID:24245544

classes.core_structure: 双喹嗪啶骨架 (bis-quinolizidine, 含1-2个喹嗪啶环系统)

rules.description: 苦参碱型(matrine-type)喹嗪啶生物碱: 特征性丢失C5H7NO(97 Da)和C5H9NO(99 Da)产生m/z 150和148。matrine [M+H]+ 249→150(基峰级, 苦参碱型DFI)→148→136; sophocarpine 247→150→148→136。氧化苦参碱先丢失O(16 Da)再按苦参碱规则裂解。m/z 150为苦参碱型通用诊断碎片
rules.mechanism: 喹嗪啶环裂解 (Ring fragmentation of quinolizidine)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 150为喹嗪啶通用诊断)
rules.reference: Wu et al., Int. J. Mass Spectrom. 2013, 341-342:28-33; Dong et al., PMID:34367714; Russian Chem. Rev. RCR2745

rules.description: sparteine型: B环C6-C7和C9-C10键断裂占主导, 产生m/z 150, 149, 98。cytisine(含吡啶酮): [M+H]+ 191→160(-CH2NH2, 31 Da)→148(-HNCO)→146。lupanine: m/z 249→150→136→98。各QA亚型由m/z 150/149/148/136的相对丰度区分
rules.reference: FAB-MS of bis-quinolizidine; bioRxiv 2022 QA metabolic; LC-MS/MS library of 75 QAs

classes.core_structure: 喹啉母核 (quinoline, C9H7N)

rules.description: 喹啉生物碱的裂解由喹啉环稳定性和取代基决定。喜树碱: 特征丢失CO2(44, 内酯环)→CO(28)→H2O(18)。奎宁/奎尼丁: 丢失H2O→产生含喹啉环碎片m/z 136-174。4-甲氧基-2-芳基喹啉(如cuspareine)丢失OCH3(31 Da)
rules.mechanism: 内酯环脱羧 / 取代基丢失
rules.reference: PMID:264141753; Sci. Rep. quinoline MS; ScienceDirect camptothecin MS/MS

rules.description: 呋喃喹啉生物碱(dictamnine, skimmianine等): 特征丢失CH3(15, 甲氧基)和CO(28)。呋喃环的引入改变裂解路径: 与简单喹啉相比有额外的呋喃环开环碎片。skimmianine: 260→227(OCH3)→212(CH3)
rules.mechanism: 甲氧基脱甲基 + 呋喃环裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(呋喃喹啉诊断)
rules.reference: J. Nat. Prod. Hancock alkaloids ACS 2018; PMID:264141753

classes.core_structure: 2-氨基-1-苯基-1-丙醇骨架 (phenylpropanolamine core)

rules.description: 麻黄碱类以丢失H2O(18 Da, 来自β-OH脱水)为首要裂解, 随后丢失胺片段(CH2NH2 31 Da / CH2NHCH3 45 Da)。ephedrine/pseudoephedrine: 166→148(H2O)→117(累积丢失H2O+CH2NH)。麻黄碱和伪麻黄碱质谱完全相同(非对映异构体, 需色谱分离)。甲基麻黄碱: 180→162(H2O)→148(-CH2NHCH3), m/z差14 Da(CH2)可区分N-甲基化程度
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(麻黄碱类通用)
rules.reference: DSHS Cologne Proceedings 2015; PMID:30668887; MDPI Molecules 2023 Kakkonto LC-MS

classes.core_structure: 多种含氮杂环骨架(加兰他敏型/石蒜碱型/水仙环素型/文珠兰碱型等)

rules.description: 加兰他敏型: 特征碎片m/z 231, 213, 198(连续脱水+环裂解)。石蒜碱型: 优先脱水m/z 288→270→252后产生含氮杂环碎片m/z 227。两者MW均为287但碎片模式不同: galanthamine→m/z 231(DFI), lycorine→m/z 227(DFI)。QToF已报道59个石蒜科生物碱的精确质量和ESI-MS/MS碎片(13个lycorine型, 10个galanthamine型, 19个crinane型)
rules.mechanism: 连续脱水 + 含氮环裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(加兰他敏型vs石蒜碱型区分)
rules.reference: Torras-Claveria et al. 2021, QToF of 59 Amaryllidaceae alkaloids; PMC6332018 (cited 49)

rules.description: 文珠兰碱(crinine)型: [M+H]+ 272→254(H2O)→236(2H2O)→222。水鬼蕉碱(tazettine)型: m/z 314→296(H2O)→278。homolycorine型: m/z 302→284(H2O)→266。各亚型由母离子m/z和脱水级联模式区分
rules.reference: Wiley RCM GC-MS of crinine-type 2023; Torras-Claveria 2021

classes.core_structure: 甾体骨架含氮(solanidane/spirosolane/tomatane型)

rules.fragment_mz: 茄碱苷元 solanidine: 398→380(H2O)→362(2H2O)→344; 糖苷: 顺序丢失糖基→苷元
rules.description: 甾体生物碱糖苷(茄碱、番茄碱)首先顺序丢失糖单元(同甾体皂苷), 产生苷元碎片。茄碱苷元(solanidine, solanidane型): [M+H]+ 398→380(H2O)→362。番茄碱苷元(tomatidine, spirosolane型): [M+H]+ 416→398(H2O)。solanidane vs spirosolane由苷元m/z差异区分(差18 Da, 因含氧)
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键顺序断裂 → 苷元脱水
rules.reference: Friedman et al., J. Agric. Food Chem. 2003; PMID:14705915

classes.core_structure: 甾体母核(环戊烷并多氢菲) + 特定官能团

rules.description: 雄激素和孕激素以丢失H2O和产生低m/z A/B环碎片(如m/z 97, 79)为特征。糖皮质激素(皮质醇等): 连续脱水级联(3个OH基, -18×3)。雌激素(雌二醇): m/z 183为芳香A环特征碎片。孕酮: m/z 97为诊断性A环碎片
rules.mechanism: 脱水级联(含OH甾体) / A环碎片化
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(甾体激素亚类诊断)
rules.reference: PMC3634331 (steroid hormone MS review); Frontiers Chem. 2022, 17 adrenal steroids; Thermo TN-64915

rules.description: 维生素D类以丢失H2O为最特征反应(因C3-β-OH), 脱水离子[M+H-H2O]+通常强于[M+H]+。25(OH)D3进一步丢失第二分子H2O。维生素D2 vs D3: D2含额外28 Da(C28 vs C27), 由前体m/z区分
rules.reference: Agilent VitD analysis; SCIEX VitD/steroid panel; PMID:3634331

classes.core_structure: 多羟基甾体(胆甾烷骨架, 通常含6-8个OH)

rules.description: 蜕皮甾酮以连续多步脱水为最特征裂解(5-8个OH基): [M+H]+ 481→463→445→427→409→391(可高达6次脱水)。侧链(C20-C27)丢失产生m/z 363碎片。m/z 99为甾体A/B环碎片(DFI)。C-7/C-15官能团类型决定环裂解位置(b/a系列离子)。ecdysone(MW 464): 465→447→429。makisterone A(MW 494): 495→477→459
rules.mechanism: 多步脱水级联 + 侧链丢失 + 环裂解
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失级联(蜕皮甾酮诊断)
rules.reference: ResearchGate ecdysteroid fragmentation; Agilent 5989-8879EN; ScienceDirect HPLC-MS/MS ecdysones 2022

classes.core_structure: 含氨基的小分子(脂肪胺/芳香胺)

rules.fragment_mz: dopamine: 154→137(NH3)→119(H2O)→91(C7H7+, tropylium); serotonin: 177→160(NH3)→132(-CO)→115(indole); putrescine: 89→72(NH3)→58; spermidine: 146→129(NH3)→112(2NH3); spermine: 203→186(NH3)→129(-aminopropyl)
rules.description: 生物胺以丢失NH3 (17 Da)为最特征反应。儿茶酚胺(多巴胺): 优先丢NH3→m/z 137, 然后H2O→119, 最终产生tropylium离子m/z 91。5-羟色胺: m/z 177→160(-NH3)→132(-CO)→115(indole fragment)。组胺: 112→95(-NH3)→68(imidazole)。多胺类: putrescine m/z 89→72→58; spermidine m/z 146→129→112; spermine m/z 203→186→129(-aminopropyl 74 Da)。多胺类序列丢失aminopropyl(74 Da)和aminobutyl(88 Da)单元
rules.mechanism: 脱氨 (NH3 loss) + 脱水 (H2O loss)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(生物胺通用诊断)
rules.reference: ACS J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 2021 phenethylamine; PMC4166658 neurotransmitter LC-MS; PMC10861277 polyamine MS

classes.core_structure: 含多个甲氧基的黄酮母核 (multi-methoxylated flavone)

rules.description: PMFs以连续丢失CH3·(15 Da)和OCH3·(31 Da)自由基为最特征裂解模式。nobiletin(6个OCH3): 403→388(-CH3)→358(-2OCH3)→342→327。tangeretin(5个OCH3): 373→358(-CH3)→343(-CH3)→328。每个OCH3丢失后可能产生自由基碎片(奇电子离子)
rules.mechanism: 连续脱甲基 (Sequential CH3/OCH3 radical loss)
rules.reference: ACS J. Agric. Food Chem. 2013, PMF pharmacokinetics; ScienceDirect Food Chem. 2025 PMF characterization; PMID:21885228

classes.core_structure: 黄酮母核含异戊烯基(3,3-二甲基烯丙基)取代

rules.description: 异戊烯基黄酮以丢失异戊烯基侧链为特征: 丢失C4H8(56 Da, 异丁烯)或C5H8(68 Da, 异戊二烯)。黄腐酚(查尔酮型): [M-H]- 353→297(-C4H8)→233(-C8H8O)→179(A环RDA碎片, DFI)。异黄腐酚(黄酮型): 先糖环化再按黄酮规则裂解
rules.mechanism: 异戊烯基消除 (Prenyl group loss as C4H8/C5H8) + RDA
rules.diagnostic_type: 中性丢失(异戊烯基诊断)
rules.reference: Frontiers Nutr. 2020; J. Chromatogr. A 2009; Semantic Scholar prenylated flavonoid MS; OSU xanthohumol thesis

classes.class: 姜黄素类/二芳基庚烷类
classes.core_structure: 两个芳环经七碳链连接 (diarylheptanoid: Ar-C7-Ar)
example_compounds: 双脱甲氧基姜黄素 Bisdemethoxycurcumin

rules.description: 姜黄素类ESI-MS/MS: 正离子模式, [M+H]+ 369→177(关键诊断碎片, 来源于庚烷链断裂产生的半分子离子)→149(-CO)。负离子: [M-H]- 367→217→175→149。三个姜黄素类共享m/z 177诊断碎片。DMC [M+H]+ 339→177; BDMC [M+H]+ 309→177
rules.mechanism: 庚烷链断裂 (heptanoid chain cleavage) → 半分子碎片
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 177, 姜黄素类DFI)
rules.reference: Jiang & Timmermann, J. Chromatogr. A 2006; PMID:16490201; SLJ Sri Lanka MS; Wiley RCM curcuminoid fragmentation

rules.description: 三个姜黄素类可由前体离子m/z区分: curcumin [M+H]+ 369(2×OCH3), demethoxycurcumin 339(1×OCH3), bisdemethoxycurcumin 309(0×OCH3)。甲氧基化程度由前体m/z差30 Da(OCH2)确定。脱甲氧基衍生物碎片少一步CH3丢失
rules.diagnostic_type: 前体离子质量差异(甲氧基数区分)
rules.reference: ACS J. Agric. Food Chem. 2008; Nature Sci. Rep. 2025 curcuma metabolomics

rules.fragment_mz: curcumin [M+H]+ 369→245(基峰, -C7H8O2 guaiacol)→175(double retro-aldol); DMC 339→245→175; BDMC 309→187→143
rules.description: 姜黄素正离子DFT证实机制: [M+H]+ 369→245.0808(丢失2-methoxyphenol/guaiacol 124 Da, 基峰, 经Nazarov型环化)→175(double retro-aldol)。DMC: 339→245(同样丢失2-methoxyphenol)→175。BDMC(无甲氧基): 309→187→143, 无m/z 245碎片(甲氧基对环化机制至关重要)。负离子: curcumin 367→217(retro-aldol)→175→149
rules.mechanism: Nazarov型环化→2-methoxyphenol消除(正离子); retro-aldol(负离子)
rules.neutral_loss: C7H8O2 (124, guaiacol, 正离子) / retro-aldol (负离子)
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(正离子m/z 245为curcumin/DMC基峰DFI)
rules.reference: Cyriac et al., J. Am. Soc. Mass Spectrom. 2019; PMID:31080356; PMC6508607

classes.core_structure: 二氢黄酮醇(taxifolin) + 松柏醇(coniferyl alcohol)通过氧化偶联

rules.description: 黄酮木脂素以产生taxifolin(二氢黄酮醇)碎片m/z 301(负离子)或303(正离子)为诊断特征。silybin [M-H]- 481→301(丢失coniferyl alcohol相关部分180 Da)→253(-CO+H2O)→179(B环碎片)→151(1,3A-碎片)。所有silymarin成分共享MW 482但CID模式不同
rules.mechanism: 黄酮-木脂素键断裂 → taxifolin碎片 → 黄酮规则裂解
rules.reference: ScienceDirect Int. J. Mass Spectrom. 2012 silymarin CID; ACS J. Nat. Prod. 2007; PMID:17913795

classes.core_structure: 苯并-γ-吡喃酮 (4H-chromen-4-one, C9H6O2)

rules.description: 色原酮与黄酮共享C6-C3-C6骨架的一半(苯并吡喃酮环), 但仅有单环结构。色原酮以连续丢失CO(28 Da)和CH3(15 Da, 甲氧基化衍生物)为特征, 类似香豆素。无RDA裂解(因无双环系统)。khellin: [M+H]+ 261→246(CH3)→218(CO)→190
rules.mechanism: 脱羰基 + 脱甲基 (类似香豆素)
rules.reference: Drewes, Chroman and Related Compounds; Heterocyclic Chemistry review

classes.core_structure: 环状氨基酸序列 (cyclic backbone of amino acid residues)

rules.description: 环肽MSn裂解策略: 环肽需先开环(丢失H2O或NH3)产生线性离子, 再按线性肽规则裂解(b/y离子)。[M+Na]+加合离子通常提供更好的序列信息。[M+H]+和[M+Na]+的裂解模式不同: 钠加合物倾向于酰胺键断裂, 质子加合物倾向于选择性断裂。MS3-MS4级联对环肽测序至关重要
rules.mechanism: 开环 → 线性肽裂解 (b/y ions)
rules.reference: PMC3398611 cyclic peptide sequencing MSn; Shimadzu Q-TOF cyclosporin; TCM Jiuwei decoction MS

classes.core_structure: 多聚酚酸(咖啡酸/丹参素/迷迭香酸多聚体)

rules.fragment_mz: rosmarinic acid: [M-H]- 359→197(danshensu)→179(caffeic acid)→135(caffeic acid-CO2); salvianolic B: 717→519(-198 danshensu)→321(-198)→179(caffeic acid); salvianolic A: 493→295(-198)→185
rules.description: 丹酚酸类以丢失咖啡酰基(162 Da, C9H6O3)和丹参素(198 Da或脱水180 Da)为特征。通用DFI: m/z 197(丹参素)和m/z 179(咖啡酸)存在于所有丹酚酸中。m/z 359(迷迭香酸)为二聚及以上丹酚酸的诊断。迷迭香酸(二聚体): [M-H]- 359→197→179→161(咖啡酸-H2O)→135。丹酚酸B(四聚体): 717→519(-danshensu 198)→321(-danshensu)→359(迷迭香酸碎片)→179。丹酚酸A(三聚体): 493→295(-danshensu)→185。丹酚酸C: 491→311→293
rules.mechanism: 酯键断裂 → 咖啡酸/丹参素碎片 → 脱羧
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 179咖啡酸, m/z 197丹参素)
rules.reference: PubMed 31017297; ACS J. Agric. Food Chem. 1998; Nature Sci. Rep. 2021 Salvia phytochemical

classes.core_structure: 鞘氨醇碱基(sphingoid base) + N-酰基脂肪酸链 + 头基

subclasses.core_description: 鞘氨醇碱基 + N-酰基脂肪酸链

rules.fragment_mz: Cer(d18:1): [M+H]+ → m/z 264.2686 (d18:1 sphingosine, C18H34NO+, 双脱水鞘氨醇); Cer(d18:0): m/z 266.2843
rules.description: 神经酰胺正离子CID: 以m/z 264.2686(鞘氨醇d18:1双脱水碎片)为最诊断离子。连续脱水: [M+H]+ → [M+H-H2O]+ → [M+H-2H2O]+ → m/z 264。负离子产生脂肪酰阴离子[RCOO]-。m/z 264 vs 266可区分鞘氨醇(d18:1)和鞘烷(d18:0)碱基
rules.mechanism: 鞘氨醇碱基双脱水碎片化
rules.reference: Sullards et al., J. Biol. Chem. 2003; PMID:3205276; PMC5352698

subclasses.core_description: 神经酰胺 + 磷酸胆碱头基

rules.fragment_mz: SM: m/z 184.0733 (磷酸胆碱), NL 183 Da; [M+H-183]+ → ceramide fragment → m/z 264
rules.description: 鞘磷脂与PC共享m/z 184诊断离子和NL 183 Da。区分SM vs PC: NL 183后, SM产生ceramide碎片(→m/z 264), PC产生DAG碎片。色谱保留时间: SM通常晚于同m/z的PC(RP-LC)。另: SM有NL 59 Da(trimethylamine)
rules.mechanism: 头基碎裂(同PC) → ceramide碎片化
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 184, NL 183, 与PC区分需ceramide碎片)
rules.reference: Pulfer & Murphy, Mass Spectrom. Rev. 2003; PMID:12691095; LIPID MAPS sphingolipidomics

subclasses.subclass: 脑苷脂/神经节苷脂 (Cerebrosides & Gangliosides)
subclasses.core_description: 神经酰胺 + 糖链(半乳糖/葡萄糖 + 可能的唾液酸)

rules.fragment_mz: GlcCer: NL 162(hexose)→ceramide→m/z 264; GM3: m/z 290(Neu5Ac-H2O); GM1/GD1: NL 291/582(sialic acid×1/2)
rules.description: 脑苷脂(GlcCer/GalCer): 丢失己糖(162 Da)产生ceramide碎片→m/z 264。糖oxonium离子m/z 163(protonated hexose)。神经节苷脂: m/z 290.0881(dehydrated Neu5Ac)为所有含唾液酸鞘脂的通用诊断。单唾液酸(GM系列): NL 291 Da; 二唾液酸(GD系列): NL 582 Da; 三唾液酸(GT系列): NL 873 Da
rules.mechanism: 糖链丢失 → ceramide碎裂; 唾液酸诊断碎片
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(神经节苷脂唾液酸诊断)
rules.reference: Ikeda et al., JLR 2008; PMID:18204080; PMID:24151180 (UVPD); PMID:38287542 (2024 review)

classes.core_structure: 甘油二酯(DAG) + 糖基(半乳糖/葡萄糖)
example_compounds: 单半乳糖甘油二酯 MGDG
双半乳糖甘油二酯 DGDG

rules.description: 糖脂以[M+Na]+或[M+Li]+加合离子为佳。MGDG: 丢失半乳糖(162 Da)产生DAG碎片。DGDG: 先丢一个半乳糖(162 Da, 产生MGDG-like中间体), 再丢第二个(共324 Da)产生DAG碎片。Li+加合离子提供更好的结构诊断信息。DAG碎片进一步丢失脂肪酰链(RCOOH)揭示sn-位信息
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键断裂 → DAG碎片 → 脂肪酰链丢失
rules.reference: PMC6858605 plant glycerolipids; LIPID MAPS MGDG/DGDG; Christie, Lipid Analysis

classes.core_structure: 甜菜醛氨酸(betalamate) + 环-DOPA或氨基酸(共轭体系)

rules.description: 甜菜色素以丢失糖基(己糖162 Da, 葡萄糖醛酸176 Da)为首要裂解, 产生通用苷元离子m/z 389(betanidin)。苷元进一步丢失CO2(44 Da)→m/z 345。betanin和isobetanin为差向异构体(质谱相同, 需色谱区分)。已建立140个betalain的in silico碎片数据库
rules.mechanism: 糖苷键断裂 → 苷元脱羧
rules.diagnostic_type: 特征碎片(m/z 389 betanidin苷元, DFI)
rules.reference: PMID:39598874 betalain database 140 compounds; ACS J Agric Food Chem 2004

general_principles.description: 含六元环烯或α,β-不饱和羰基系统的化合物经RDA裂解产生一对特征性互补碎片(双烯+亲双烯体)
含羧基(-COOH)或内酯的化合物CID中丢失CO2 (44 Da)是最普遍特征之一
含羰基化合物丢失CO (28 Da)，尤其在醌类和内酯类中与CO2丢失竞争

applies_to: 几乎所有含羟基化合物
general_principles.description: 含-OH化合物极易丢失H2O (18 Da)，但非高度特异性
O-苷以丢失完整糖单元为特征(己糖162 Da, 脱氧己糖146 Da, 戊糖132 Da); C-苷以糖环交叉环裂解为特征(60, 90, 120 Da)
奇数N→偶数分子量[M+H]+; 偶数N→奇数分子量
含氮α位C-C键断裂(生物碱)或侧链α位断裂(苯丙素)
γ-H转移到不饱和基团随之β-裂解，在二萜、甾醇、香豆素苷等中常见
苄位C-C键断裂产生稳定苄基正离子或自由基
1,4-二烯体系(源自异戊二烯连接)的双烯丙基C-C键极易断裂

diagnostic_differentiation.key_difference: O-苷: 丢失完整糖基(162, 146, 132 Da); C-苷: 糖环交叉环裂解(60, 90, 120 Da)

diagnostic_differentiation.key_difference: Digitoxigenin: m/z 375→357→339 (2×H2O); Digoxigenin: m/z 391→373→355→337 (3×H2O, 多C12-OH)

diagnostic_differentiation.key_difference: Retronecine型: m/z 120; Otonecine型: m/z 138

diagnostic_differentiation.key_difference: 核苷酸: 丢失H3PO4 (98 Da)或HPO3 (80 Da); 核苷: 丢失核糖(132 Da)产生碱基碎片

diagnostic_differentiation.key_difference: PPD苷元 m/z 423.36; PPT苷元 m/z 441.37(含C-6 OH多18 Da)
